items.difficulty_reason: Smoothing-unobstructedness for a curve with isolated non-smooth points: original two-affine cover engineering (affine open through the singular points and all generic points, second affine open off them), then smoothness of Def_X -> Def_U2 via the chapter's glueing-smooth lemma and conclusion through the affine and isolated lemmas; the cover construction is the load-bearing part and is written out. Retained author proof at lines 3054-3070.
